workstation.label: workstation 1
workstation.note: Same machine as W1-S01/ENV-0001: identical OS build, CPU family and GPU driver versions. NOT a new evidence cell for S-01.

edge-152.kind: branded Microsoft Edge, Playwright channel msedge

mode: headful (the headless shell cannot load extensions at all)

machine_changes.REASON: Drive a Chromium build that honours --load-extension; matches the version used by W1-S01b and W1-S02a-2b.
machine_changes.IMPACT: node_modules inside this experiment's harness directory only; gitignored. No global change, no browser downloaded.

known_limitations: One machine, one OS, two Chromium-family browsers. Nothing here generalises to Firefox.

Playwright's own browser download FAILED on this machine (npx playwright install chromium -> 'Download failure, code=1'), the same symptom W1-S01b recorded on workstation 2. Browsers already present were used instead.
The Chromium build is 151.0.7922.34, one major behind the Edge cell (152) and behind branded Chrome 152. Both agreed unanimously, but neither is the exact CI binary.
